page.overview:
Who is Amrita?

As a lieutenant of Jargala Omo, Amrita performed well as a mobster in the Creeping Crystal Triad. However, her real dream was always to leave her life of crime and break into the mover industry as a director. Amrita had been enamored with movers since the first one she saw, and she started looking for a way in, however she could get there.

When the triad gave a loan to Hongmei to start his own mover company, Amrita kept an eye on him as a source for more "fruitful" business endeavors. However, Hongmei did all he could to cut ties and keep Amrita out, which she took personally.

Despite her continued efforts, Amrita had not been able to push her way in to control any mover company. Those that would accept her overtures of aid were too small or unimportant to satisfy her ambitions, and those that were both successful and big were not willing to shackle themselves to the Creeping Crystal Triad and Amrita. Varrimovers International ended up being in just the right position for Amrita, as while it had major clout as a studio, it ended up having serious budgetary problems. Because of his prior history with the triad, and the desperate state of affairs at the mover company, Hongmei was Amrita's best chance to get everything she wanted and had promised to Jargala.

However, the triad's leader was tired of Amrita and her mover obsession. Jargala ordered Amrita to come back with something real and profitable within a month, or she would move the lieutenant to a different district and see if the Creeping Crystal Triad could muscle in on something more lucrative, like the waste disposal industry. After Jargala's ultimatum, Amrita met with Hongmei as the studio prepared for its new big, flashy mover, Sengo: Lady of the Winds. Amrita made it clear to him that he would be accepting Creeping Crystal yuan in exchange for a percentage of the mover's success, in order to satisfy Jargala. Amrita also demanded that she become an executive producer at Varrimovers International to satisfy her own ambitions. Hongmei refused these terms, but Amrita was ready for this. Knowing that the mover company was in a desperate position and that the scheduled premiere was the last shot at making Sengo a success. She therefore thought that she just had to put enough pressure on the executive to make him think that he wouldn't finish the mover in time, as she was absolutely sure he would break.
